# Analyze peak windows and boat performance across all seasons
import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']

# Filter out practice seasons (1-2), only look at real data (season >= 3)
trips_live = trips[trips['fished_date_season'] >= 3].copy()

# Peak by day-of-year (across all real seasons)
doy_peaks = trips_live.groupby('fished_date_doy').agg({
    'boat': 'count',
    'yt': 'sum'
}).rename(columns={'boat': 'trips'})
doy_peaks['yt_per_trip'] = (doy_peaks['yt'] / doy_peaks['trips']).round(2)
doy_peaks = doy_peaks.sort_values('yt_per_trip', ascending=False)

print("=== TOP 20 PEAK DAYS (by yt/trip, all real seasons 3+) ===")
print(doy_peaks[['trips', 'yt', 'yt_per_trip']].head(20))

print("\n=== TOP 20 BOATS (all seasons 3+) ===")
boat_perf = trips_live.groupby('boat').agg({
    'boat': 'count',
    'yt': 'sum'
}).rename(columns={'boat': 'trips'})
boat_perf['yt_per_trip'] = (boat_perf['yt'] / boat_perf['trips']).round(2)
boat_perf = boat_perf.sort_values('yt_per_trip', ascending=False)
print(boat_perf[['trips', 'yt', 'yt_per_trip']].head(20))

print("\n=== SEASON 6 SPECIFIC: Peak days and boats ===")
